item.title: From Micro to Nano: Boosting γ-MnO2 Cathode Performance through Particle Size Engineering
item.description:
مهندسی اندازه ذرات γ-MnO2 نشان می‌دهد نانوذرات با مسیرهای کوتاه‌تر Li+ ظرفیت ۱۶۰.۱ mAh g−1 و نگهداشت ۷۰٪ پس از ۴۰۰ چرخه در ۳C را فراهم می‌کنند.
Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Nanosized γ-MnO2 (62 nm) outperforms micron-sized counterparts, delivering 160.1 mAh g–1, 66% capacity at 5C, and 70% retention after 400 cycles. Enhanced capacitive contribution (68.9%) and homogeneous solid-solution intercalation avoid phase-transition bottlenecks. This establishes particle-size engineering as a simple, effective route to fast-charging, long-life MnO2 cathodes.
🏷 gamma-MnO2 · particle size · lithium-ion battery · fast charging · intercalation kinetics

item.description:

Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a protonated polyaniline-modified MXene/CNT scaffold that immobilizes iodine and accelerates polyiodide conversion while ensuring conductivity. This suppresses the shuttle effect, enabling a high iodine loading of 43.96 wt%, 150 mAh g–1 at 20 C, and 10,000-cycle stability. It offers a viable strategy for stable, high-performance Zn–I2 battery cathodes.
🏷 zinc-iodine battery · MXene · polyaniline · iodine cathode · shuttle effect
